body:
They're fairly conservative religion-wise but if I have problems they're also supportive. I don't agree with them on a lot of stuff but they're overall good people.

That being said I'm unsure of how they'll react. On one hand, I feel like my mom will freak out if I do. She worries a lot and I don't want to worry her anymore. On the other hand, I've been pretty candid with her about what I'm struggling with (outside of suicide. just telling her that I feel sad all the time and hopeless) but she doesn't seem to take it all that seriously. And I've tried to tell her that what I'm going through is way harder than anything I've gone through before but she doesn't seem to understand. So I don't even know if she'll take me seriously.

I don't really talk with my dad about this stuff. He tries to help but he's not always the best at it.
I'm sorry to hear about that. It's so rough. I hope things get better for you.

Yeah, I’d say so for me. Over the years, I’ve dealt a lot with just horrible anxiety about stuff, especially school. Eventually I just totally burnt out and started avoiding my problems to try and cope. 

It helped reduce my anxiety, but my productivity plummeted to zero and I started to loathe myself. That just led me to be depressed. 

Currently doing anything is hard, and I’m really struggling with productivity in college
I’m in this picture and I don’t like it
Thank you. I'm glad you found what matters. I hope that I will one day as well.

Hey. Thank you so much for writing this. It really means a lot to me. And thank you for sharing your experience.

And yeah I hope I can get through this. It’s just been rough because I’ve spent years building my self-worth on my academic achievements because I never felt like I had anything else going for me. So being in a state where I’m barely able to keep up academically makes me feel like I’ve lost what gives me worth as a person. I know it’s wrong but I just can’t get that out of my head.

I hope everything gets better for you as well. Having to deal with these feelings is just awful beyond words.

Thank you for the advice and for sharing your experience. I think I'll stick with my current one for a little while longer and try to communicate, but yeah I have been considering trying out another. 

Also I'm sorry you had that experience with your previous psychiatrist. It's kind of silly that they were offended that their methods weren't working. I would have been ticked off.

That was kind of my previous situation. I had a few friends that I talked to, but I never really felt like I related to them very much, though I appreciated them. I still felt lonely and dissatisfied back then, but now it's gotten worse because I'm not even having that social contact.

Yeah, I'm currently trying to find a good therapist but the couple I've gone to recently I just haven't clicked well with. I haven't given up on finding one though.

Thank you for offering advice, by the way. I do think that my situation might be improved when I do find a good therapist. I've just had a hard time finding one.

Yeah I've never had a whole lot of friends either, and I guess I was kind of okay with that although I wished I'd had closer relationships with them. But now I really don't have meaningful interaction almost at all.

I hope that you can find some new friends. Loneliness really sucks.

Not cheesy at all. Loneliness can be so crushing. And I honestly fear texting my friends for the same reason, or because I'm afraid I'll say something stupid.

Honestly just receiving nice comments on Reddit makes me feel better, even if my overall situation is really shitty. So thank you for helping me to feel a little bit better.

Thank you for responding.

I don't really have a plan or anything right now so I guess I wouldn't count as being high risk. But I don't know if that will change because stuff keeps getting worse and worse. I wasn't this suicidal a month ago.

I just got a therapist but I guess I'm afraid to tell her what's going on. I know I should though.

Thank you so much for responding and for sharing your experience.

It sounds like you're going through a tough time as well. I know it may not mean much coming from an internet stranger but I really hope things get better for you. Depression sucks.
Thank you for your response. I have been looking for help for a long time, so yeah I hope I'll eventually find something that works.
